experiment: E4-6.1 fixed Codex-wrapper descriptive repeat, CLI 0.160.0
execution: strictly serial; one new ephemeral thread per observation

weekly_quota_stop_condition.note: 2% is a safety margin, not a hard cap; one request may cross a displayed integer boundary

failure_policy: Only explicit failed with no final text may retry once; permission/quota/rate/model/safety/tool signals stop; two consecutive final-missing items stop
invalid_final_text_policy: preserve raw completed text and apply the frozen original extractor/evaluator once
missing_completion_policy: mark missing/failed, exclude from accuracy denominator, and do not encode as an incorrect prediction
tool_policy: official process-local feature disables plus web disabled; any emitted tool item or client action request stops the batch
wrapper_policy: each thread must match the audited instruction-source path/content hashes and contain no project task data
state_policy: same locked R4B memory-rendered prompt; no training, candidate generation, or conversational carryover
